product_overview: DebtTrack is a web-based dashboard for tracking client debts, payments, and activity across devices. It provides quick inline debt operations, searchable/filterable client lists, demo and admin modes, currency and language toggles, and a detailed client page.
core_goals: Provide a fast, glanceable dashboard showing client debt metrics and a searchable client list.
Enable instant inline debt operations (record payment, add debt) without page navigation.
Support both Demo (localStorage) and Admin (Supabase-authenticated) modes with clear mode indicators.
Offer mobile-first UX including expandable client cards and a fixed bottom navigation.
Support currency switching (USD/IQD) and language direction toggling (English/Arabic).
Ensure clear error handling for validation and network failures.

features.name: Dashboard Load
features.description: Render the main dashboard with header, stat cards, and client list reliably on the root route.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Page loads and displays sticky glassmorphism header with "DebtTrack" branding -> Four stat cards are visible showing Total Clients, Total Collected, Outstanding Debt, Active Projects -> Client list panel renders below the stats
Navigate to / -> Page shows loading spinner while data initializes -> Data fails to load (network or localStorage error) -> Show error toast or visible empty state message instead of client list

features.name: Quick Add Money (Reduce Debt)
features.description: Allow users to record a client payment inline from the dashboard, reducing outstanding debt and updating the progress bar.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the green "Add Money" button on a client card or table row -> An inline input form appears with auto-focus -> Enter a numeric amount in the input field -> Click the green checkmark button to confirm -> See success toast -> Debt amount decreases -> Progress bar updates to reflect the new payment

Navigate to / -> Click the green "Add Money" button on a client card or table row -> An inline input form appears with auto-focus -> Enter non-numeric or negative value in the input field -> Press Enter to confirm -> See inline validation error or error toast -> Debt amount remains unchanged

Navigate to / -> Click the green "Add Money" button on a client card or table row -> An inline input form appears with auto-focus -> Enter a valid numeric amount -> Click the green checkmark button to confirm -> POST /api/clients/payment fails -> See error toast and the inline form remains open for retry

features.name: Quick Add Debt
features.description: Allow users to add new debt to a client inline from the dashboard, increasing outstanding balance and updating related metrics.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the red "Add Debt" button on a client card or table row -> An inline input form appears with auto-focus -> Enter a numeric amount representing new debt -> Click the red checkmark button to confirm -> See success toast -> Outstanding balance increases

Navigate to / -> Click the red "Add Debt" button on a client card or table row -> An inline input form appears with auto-focus -> Enter empty or invalid input -> Press Enter -> See inline validation error -> Outstanding balance remains unchanged

Navigate to / -> Click the red "Add Debt" button on a client card or table row -> An inline input form appears -> Enter a valid numeric amount -> Click the red checkmark to confirm -> PUT /api/clients returns server error -> See error toast and original balance persists

features.name: Client Search
features.description: Filter the client list in real-time by name or phone number using the search input on the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Type "Ali" in the search input field -> Client list filters in real-time to match the search query by name or phone -> Clear the search input -> Full client list restores
Navigate to / -> Type a query that matches no clients -> Client list updates to show an empty state with a "No results" or similar message

features.name: Client Status Filter
features.description: Filter clients by status using pill buttons (ALL, LEAD, ACTIVE, PENDING, SUSPENDED).
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click status pill button "ACTIVE" -> Client list filters to show only clients with that status -> Active pill is highlighted in gold
Navigate to / -> Click status pill button "SUSPENDED" when no suspended clients exist -> Client list shows empty state and pill highlights appropriately

features.name: Smart Filters and Sort
features.description: Provide advanced filters and sort options from a dropdown to refine the client list (DEBT, PAID, HIGH_VALUE, ACTIVE, DORMANT; sort: Highest Debt First, Last Payment).
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the "Filter" button to open dropdown -> Select smart filter "DEBT" -> Select sort option "Highest Debt First" -> Client list updates accordingly
Navigate to / -> Click the "Filter" button to open dropdown -> Select filter that yields no results (e.g., HIGH_VALUE when none exist) -> Client list displays empty state and a clear message

features.name: Mobile Expandable Client Card
features.description: On mobile screen widths, each client card can be tapped to expand and reveal quick action buttons and details.
user_flows: On a narrow screen (mobile) -> Navigate to / -> Tap on a client card -> Card expands to show detailed financials, Add Money and Add Debt buttons, and a "View Full Details" link -> Tap again to collapse
On a narrow screen (mobile) -> Navigate to / -> Tap an already-expanded client card when its data is missing or corrupted -> Card shows a fallback message or remains collapsed

features.name: Add New Client
features.description: Create a new client via a modal dialog accessible from desktop header and mobile floating button, updating lists and stats.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the "Add Client" button in the header (desktop) or the "+" floating button in the bottom nav (mobile) -> A modal dialog opens with form fields: Name, Phone, Industry, Price Quoted, Amount Paid, Status -> Fill in required fields and submit -> New client appears in the list and stat cards update

Navigate to / -> Click the "Add Client" button -> Modal dialog opens -> Submit the form with missing required fields -> See field validation errors in the modal -> Modal remains open and client is not created
Navigate to / -> Click the "Add Client" button -> Fill form and submit -> POST /api/clients fails or network error -> See error toast and form stays open for retry

features.name: Demo Mode
features.description: Allow unauthenticated users to use the app with sample data stored in localStorage and operate locally with a Demo Mode badge.
user_flows: Navigate to / without logging in -> Demo Mode badge shown in header -> Sample clients are visible and operations work locally -> Perform add/edit operations -> Data persists to localStorage
Navigate to / without logging in -> Demo Mode badge shown -> Click Reset button -> Demo data cleared from localStorage -> Client list shows default empty/demo state
Navigate to / without logging in -> localStorage unavailable (e.g., private mode) -> Attempt a demo operation -> Show error toast explaining demo storage is unavailable

features.name: Authentication Sign In
features.description: Admin users sign in at /login to access Supabase-backed data; sign-in toggles Admin Mode badge and real data.
user_flows: On any page -> Click "Sign In" button in header or bottom nav -> Redirected to /login -> Enter credentials and submit -> POST /api/auth/callback/credentials succeeds -> Redirected back to / -> Admin Mode badge visible
On any page -> Click "Sign In" button in header -> Redirected to /login -> Enter invalid credentials and submit -> Authentication returns error -> See credential error message and remain on /login

features.name: Currency Toggle
features.description: Switch between USD and IQD in the header to update all displayed monetary values.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the currency selector in the header -> Select IQD -> All monetary values on the page update to the selected currency display
Navigate to / -> Click the currency selector -> Select IQD -> Conversion lookup fails or is unavailable -> Show error toast and retain previous currency display

features.name: Language Toggle
features.description: Switch between English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL) via the header control, updating UI text and layout direction.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the language toggle button in the header -> Page text switches to Arabic -> Page direction changes to RTL
Navigate to / -> Click the language toggle button -> Some keys lack translations -> UI falls back to English for missing strings and shows fallback message or raw keys

features.name: Delete Client
features.description: Remove a client from the list using the trash icon with a browser confirmation prompt and server delete.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Hover over a client row on desktop to reveal the delete (trash) icon -> Click the trash icon -> Confirm the deletion in the browser confirm dialog -> Client is removed from the list and stat cards update
Navigate to / -> Hover over a client row and click trash icon -> Confirm deletion -> DELETE /api/clients fails -> Show error toast and client remains in the list

features.name: Bottom Navigation Bar (Mobile)
features.description: A fixed bottom nav on mobile devices provides quick access to Home, Clients, Add (+), Stats, and Sign In/Out actions.
user_flows: On mobile (narrow width) -> Navigate to / -> Bottom nav bar is visible at the bottom of the screen -> Tap the Add (+) icon -> Add Client modal opens
On mobile -> Navigate to / -> Tap the Sign In/Out icon when unauthenticated -> Navigate to /login -> If sign-in fails show error toast
On desktop width -> Navigate to / -> Bottom nav bar is not visible -> Attempt to use mobile nav does nothing (UI unavailable) and user uses header controls instead

features.name: Client Detail Page
features.description: Full client edit view at /admin/client with payment history, notes, and invoice generation; requires a valid client id query param.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/client?id=123 -> Page loads with full edit form populated for client 123 -> Payment history and notes are visible -> Make an edit and save -> Changes persist
Navigate to /admin/client without an id query param -> Page shows an empty or error state with a message indicating a missing or invalid client id
